description: Subscriptions, APIs and cloud accounts, from the spend tracker's Postgres table (card transactions via Monarch, classified by files/spend-tracker/vendors.json).

panels.title: This month
panels.description: Charges since the 1st, so it reads low until the month is over.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS spend FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('month', now())

panels.title: Last month to the same day
panels.description: The fair comparison for the month so far: last month's charges up to the same day of the month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS spend FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND date <= (now() - interval '1 month')::date
SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS spend FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND date < date_trunc('month', now())

panels.title: Monthly run rate
panels.description: Monthly and usage charges averaged over the last 3 full months, plus each annual vendor's latest charge divided by 12. Reads low until there are 3 full months of data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) / 3 FROM spend WHERE cadence <> 'annual' AND date >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '3 months' AND date < date_trunc('month', now())) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) / 12 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (vendor) amount FROM spend WHERE cadence = 'annual' AND date >= now() - interval '13 months' ORDER BY vendor, date DESC) latest) AS run_rate
SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS spend FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('year', now())

panels.title: Last year
panels.description: The whole previous calendar year. Only as complete as the card history Monarch holds for it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS spend FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('year', now()) - interval '1 year' AND date < date_trunc('year', now())

panels.title: Charged per month by vendor
panels.description: What actually hit the cards each month. An annual charge lands whole in its month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, vendor, sum(amount) AS spend FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Amortized per month by kind
panels.description: The same charges grouped by how they bill, with each annual one spread evenly over the 12 months it pays for. Monthly plans and usage are untouched, so only the annual band differs from the panel above: it is flat here where it spikes there.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, kind, sum(amount) AS spend FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', date) AS m, CASE cadence WHEN 'usage' THEN 'Usage' ELSE 'Monthly plans' END AS kind, amount FROM spend WHERE cadence <> 'annual' UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('month', date) + make_interval(months => n), 'Annual plans, a twelfth each month', amount / 12 FROM spend CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 11) AS n WHERE cadence = 'annual') spread WHERE m >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND m <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, sum(amount) AS charged FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Annual renewals
panels.description: Latest charge per annual vendor and the date it is due again.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (vendor) vendor, amount, to_char(date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS last_charged, to_char(date + interval '1 year', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS next_due FROM spend WHERE cadence = 'annual' ORDER BY vendor, date DESC

SELECT to_char(date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, vendor, amount, cadence FROM spend WHERE date >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND date <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz ORDER BY date DESC, vendor
